Messages.Author: Creature
Messages.Body:
As far as I can tell, this is perfectly legal.

I was looking at the "Cooler" card, which I found mostly useless. But
now, is this possible?

Stack multiple Coolers and Blood Dools on a single minion (with normal
equip actions, or Pier 13 even better) and take back from multiple
coolers during your untap phase. Nothing seems to limit this. This
could easily become a great pool generation method!

Is this assumption correct? If so, I finally found how to make my
bleeding the vine deck work!
